UpdateSourceArgs: -c "AUTH_BAK=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.steam-auth\"; DEST=\"$HOME/Steam/config\"; mkdir -p \"$DEST\" \"$AUTH_BAK\"; if [[ -f \"$AUTH_BAK/config.vdf\" ]] && ! grep -q ConnectCache \"$DEST/config.vdf\" 2>/dev/null; then cp -a \"$AUTH_BAK/config.vdf\" \"$DEST/config.vdf\" && echo \"Restored SteamCMD config.vdf from auth backup\"; fi; if compgen -G \"$AUTH_BAK/ssfn*\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then cp -a \"$AUTH_BAK\"/ssfn* \"$HOME/Steam/\" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; true"

-c "AUTH_BAK=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.steam-auth\"; SRC=\"$HOME/Steam/config/config.vdf\"; mkdir -p \"$AUTH_BAK\"; if [[ -f \"$SRC\" ]] && grep -qE 'ConnectCache|RefreshToken|AccountName' \"$SRC\" 2>/dev/null; then cp -a \"$SRC\" \"$AUTH_BAK/config.vdf\" && echo \"Backed up SteamCMD auth to .steam-auth/\"; fi; if compgen -G \"$HOME/Steam/ssfn*\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then cp -a \"$HOME/Steam\"/ssfn* \"$AUTH_BAK/\" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; true"

-c "for pkg in python3 jq; do command -v $pkg >/dev/null 2>&1 || NEED=\"$NEED $pkg\"; done; [ -z \"$NEED\" ] || (export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq $NEED)"

-c "if [[ ! -f \"{{$FullBaseDir}}AssettoCorsaEVOServer.exe\" ]]; then echo 'Server exe missing; skip launch wrapper until SteamCMD succeeds'; exit 0; fi; python3 \"{{$FullBaseDir}}prepare_launch.py\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\""

/c if exist "{{$FullBaseDir}}AssettoCorsaEVOServer.exe" (py -3 "{{$FullBaseDir}}prepare_launch.py" "{{$FullBaseDir}}" 2>nul || python "{{$FullBaseDir}}prepare_launch.py" "{{$FullBaseDir}}") else (echo Server exe missing & exit /b 0)

-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; mkdir -p \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/compatdata\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}.steam/steam\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}.steam/sdk32\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}.steam/sdk64\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}.config/protonfixes\" && { \cp -f \"{{$FullRootDir}}linux32/steamclient.so\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}.steam/sdk32/\" 2>/dev/null || true; } && { \cp -f \"{{$FullRootDir}}linux64/steamclient.so\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}.steam/sdk64/\" 2>/dev/null || true; }; ProtonVersion=\"{{SpecificReleaseVersion}}\" && if [[ -x \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/proton\" && -f \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/version\" ]]; then read _ InstalledVersion < \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/version\"; else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; if [[ -z \"$ProtonVersion\" ]]; then ProtonVersion=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name); fi; if [[ ! \"$ProtonVersion\" =~ ^GE-Proton[0-9]+-[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Proton GE release version format specified\" && exit 1; elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$ProtonVersion\"* ]]; then echo \"Proton GE version $ProtonVersion already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f GE-Proton.tar.gz ]] && rm -f GE-Proton.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO GE-Proton.tar.gz https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/releases/download/$ProtonVersion/$ProtonVersion.tar.gz || { echo \"Proton GE download failed from GitHub. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/compatdata/\"* >/dev/null 2>&1; tar -xzf GE-Proton.tar.gz -C \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton\" --strip-components=1 && rm -f GE-Proton.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \"Proton GE version $ProtonVersion downloaded\" && { STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/compatdata\" STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}.steam/steam\" WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/compatdata/pfx\" PROTON_LOG=0 \"{{$FullRootDir}}.proton/proton\" waitforexitandrun cmd.exe /c exit >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; }; fi"
